name: ERA5 1991–2020 monthly climatology of 2 m temperature (30–70N), sea-level pressure and eastward surface stress (10S–10N) on 1°

source.dataset: ERA5 monthly means of daily means, NCAR RDA ds633.1 (e5.moda.an.sfc, e5.moda.fc.sfc.meanflux)
references: Hersbach et al. 2020, Q. J. R. Meteorol. Soc. 146, 1999–2049
source.license: Copernicus license (free use with attribution: "Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2025")

period: 1991-01 to 2020-12, each calendar month the mean of 30 years
box: per field: south to north, all longitudes
mask: none in the file: a box row samples it on the model's own land or sea cells (bilinear at each cell center, area-weighted)
definition: float32 little-endian, fields in this order, each [month][row][column], rows from `south` northward at 1°, columns from 0°E at 1°. Matching model quantities, all from the run's day means: t2m the model's air temperature at 2 m above its surface, not the skin and not the lowest layer (about 20 m up): the model keeps no 2 m diagnostic, so a row brings each cell's lowest-layer air to 2 m along the surface-layer profile of the run's own exchange coefficients; msl its mean sea-level pressure; metss its eastward turbulent stress on the surface (the run's exchange, not a rebuilt one).
